acceptance_scope.zh: 作者于 2026-11-04 确认当前参考交付范围验收通过：17/17；其中 9 项实际搭桥、1 项直接跨越、7 项明确拒答。7 组新版正反配对满足原定 240 秒。5 项旧参考解超时，沿用既定简化交付；不等于全部通过原始严格标准。正式准入、第二人复现、传感器驱动 agent 评测及稳健成功率不在本次签收范围。
acceptance_scope.en: The author accepted the current reference-delivery scope on 2026-11-04: 17/17, comprising 9 actual bridge-construction tasks, 1 direct crossing and 7 explicit refusals. All 7 new refusal/feasible pairs meet the original 240 seconds. Five historical references exceed that budget under the existing simplified deliverable; this is not full original-standard compliance. Formal admission, independent reproduction, sensor-only agent evaluation and robust success rates are outside this acceptance.
